title: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
abstract: arXiv:2610.35687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field

translated_title: TrySee：面向专业领域闭环机器人任务规划的模块化感知增强VLM接地方法
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型在机器人的高层推理和任务规划方面已展现出令人印象深刻的能力。然而，专业领域对VLM的图像解释和接地能力仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了TrySee，这是一个模块化的闭环机器人任务规划流水线，将通用的VLM推理与领域特定感知和成熟的机器人技术组件相集成。该系统由一个本质上是反应式的循环规划流水线构成，并通过领域特定的模块化视觉预处理进行增强，以提供在线接地。最后，动态预处理选择机制为流水线的可扩展性做出了贡献。该系统既不需要VLM微调，也不需要端到端演示，并可通过可替换的感知模块和运动规划进行适配。该方法在5个差异迥异的领域的规划任务上进行了评估，其中包括一个真实世界的机器人拆解任务。
tldr: 提出了TrySee——一个无需VLM微调的模块化闭环机器人任务规划系统，通过将通用VLM推理与可替换的领域特定感知模块相结合实现在线接地，并在包括真实机器人拆解在内的5个不同领域验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: TrySee is a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline that integrates general-purpose VLM reasoning with replaceable domain-specific perception modules for online grounding, requiring no VLM fine-tuning, and is validated across 5 diverse domains including a real-world robot disassembly task.
